entities.summary: Windows Desktop Gadgets is a widget engine for Windows Vista and Windows 7, part of the now discontinued Microsoft Gadgets widget platform. Its gadgets can perform various tasks, such as displaying the time and date, gathering RSS feed or Email information, allowing users to use tools such as sticky notes or timers, among other tasks.
